summary: School-front kerb that is too steep and signed no stopping at school times.

drivers.seclusion: School and vet clinic around it; a house with trees stands right behind the kerb, though OSM does not tag it as a dwelling.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along this kerb now, but the road falls steeply and the signed lane is narrow.
drivers.traffic: School-run road with heavy traffic at drop-off and pick-up.
drivers.convention: No Stopping signs 7-9am and school-day afternoons, passenger loading zone, 1/4P on school days; no overnight parking convention.

flags: School no-stopping times and passenger loading zone
Unmapped house close to the kerb
sun_shade: Open kerb; trees on the south side shade it from the south and west.
